bugs_found: compound_interest does not validate principal < 0 despite declared principal >= 0 input domain
compound_interest silently coerces non-integer years and compounds_per_year with int(), which can change the contracted computation instead of enforcing int inputs
loan_payment silently coerces non-integer months with int(), which can change the contracted amortization period instead of enforcing int inputs
transfer is not atomic if crediting account_to.balance fails after debiting account_from.balance
fx_convert treats a None rate as missing rather than explicitly rejecting unavailable/non-Decimal rates; this can conflate malformed table values with missing rates
